info.name: F5 XC - Vuln-Bank Setup
info.description:
Automates the full F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) setup for the **vuln-bank** demo environment via API — no manual console steps required.

## What This Collection Deploys

| Step | Resource | Name |
|------|----------|------|
| 1 | Namespace | `vuln-bank` |
| 2 | Health Check | `tcp-monitor` |
| 3 | Origin Pool | `origin-vuln-bank` |
| 4 | App Firewall Policy | `policy-vuln-bank` |
| 5 | HTTP Load Balancer | `lb-vuln-bank` |

## Setup — Collection Variables

Set these variables before running any request:

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{xc_tenant}}` | Your F5 XC tenant short name | `mycompany` |
| `{{xc_api_token}}` | API token from **Console → Administration → Credentials** | — |
| `{{vulnbank_base_url}}` | Domain for the vuln-bank app (no `https://`) | `vulnbank.example.com` |
| `{{origin_pool_ip}}` | IP address of the vuln-bank backend server | `54.255.131.161` |

> `{{xc_tenant_fullname}}` and `{{base_url}}` are set **automatically** by the Get Tenant Info request — do not set these manually.

## Execution Order

Run folders **top to bottom** in the order listed. Within each folder, run **Create** before other requests.

## References

- [F5 XC API Docs](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api)
- [Vuln-Bank Source](https://github.com/Commando-X/vuln-bank)

request.description:
Lists namespaces to resolve the full tenant name and auto-populate `{{xc_tenant_fullname}}` and `{{base_url}}` via the built-in Test script.

> **Run this first** — every subsequent request that references `{{xc_tenant_fullname}}` depends on this value.

## How It Works

Every F5 XC API response includes `metadata.tenant` with the full tenant identifier (e.g. `mycompany-abc12345`). The Test script extracts this from the first namespace in the response and stores it as a collection variable automatically.

## Variables Set by This Request

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{xc_tenant_fullname}}` | Full tenant name extracted from response | `mycompany-abc12345` |
| `{{base_url}}` | Constructed base URL for all subsequent API calls | `https://mycompany.console.ves.volterra.io` |

---

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Operation** | `ves.io.schema.namespace.API.List` |
| **Method** | `GET` |
| **Endpoint** | `/api/web/namespaces` |
| **Docs** | [F5 XC Namespace API](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/namespace) |

Creates an HTTPS Load Balancer `lb-vuln-bank` in the `vuln-bank` namespace with the following features enabled:
- **WAF** — App Firewall policy `policy-vuln-bank` (blocking mode)
- **Bot Defense** — Protected endpoints: `/login` (flag) and `/transfer` (append headers)
- **API Discovery** — API Crawler + Code Scan integration
- **API Testing** — Daily, with `admin`, `franklin`, and `john` credentials
- **Auto TLS** — Let's Encrypt certificate with HTTP→HTTPS redirect

---

item.name: Create HTTP LB with Bot Defense - lb-vuln-bank

request.description:
Creates an HTTPS Load Balancer `lb-vuln-bank` in the `vuln-bank` namespace with Bot Defense enabled.

- **WAF** — App Firewall policy `policy-vuln-bank` (blocking mode)
- **Bot Defense** — Protected endpoint: `/login` (ASIA region)
- **API Discovery** — API Crawler enabled
- **API Testing** — Daily, with `admin`, `franklin`, and `john` credentials
- **Auto TLS** — Let's Encrypt certificate with HTTP→HTTPS redirect
